thread.title_full: Nick Reiner was 'off the rails' at time of killings due to new meds: TMZ sources | Banfield

author: @KenjiMapes
text: Most mentally disturbed people or addicts aren’t violent let alone murderous. He waited until his parents went to bed apparently when they were most vulnerable. He snuck in & stabbed his parents & slashed their throats. Then he had the wherewithal to pack a bag, flee & go to a hotel to clean up his bloody mess. It’s convenient to have an insanity defense. If he was “off the rails” & got into a heated argument at the party wouldn’t it have been more of an overstimulating & public embarrassing impetus for him to have snapped then & lash out violently? Instead he waited a few hours to attack his poor parents in the late hours to attack when they were most vulnerable. That displays foresight, planning & thinking. I have a bad temper & after some time has passed you cannot help but to cool down & regroup. Any anger should have dissipated & subsided. He didn’t just snap hours later. He’s just N evil psycho who was allegedly giggling with his lawyer today. If he had an ounce of a conscience he’d be inconsolable & overwhelmed with grief & monumental debilitating guilt where he should almost be catatonic & depressed. He should feel so heavy & burdened by guilt to where he would be almost dysfunctional. It’s just sad & awful. His poor parents must have felt so betrayed at the end as their last moments here on earth were of seeing their son attack them after birthing him, raising him, loving him. He is an evil demon with the appearance of a human being
